decision.rationale: Candidate B never subscribes either mounted readout to SharedUnitStore. Its signal is initialized once from getSnapshot(), and only the north readout’s imperative toolbarWrite manually refreshes that local signal. Consequently, externalWrite leaves all mounted readouts stale, toolbarWrite leaves the south readout stale, subscriberCount remains 0 while consumers are mounted, and remount/lifecycle notification behavior cannot satisfy the shared-store contract. This is a reproducible defect directly implied by the supplied candidate, store, and harness code.
